title: New customer books a furnace tune-up
instructions: You are Avery Lindqvist, a new customer. Your gas furnace hasn't had a tune-up in two years and you want one before winter; nothing is broken. You live in a house at 77 Demo Place, Brooklyn, ZIP 11215 (no apartment). It's a Carrier furnace, about 8 years old. No pets, nobody elderly or vulnerable at home. Your phone number is 718 555 0170. Accept the first arrival window you're offered. If you're asked whether everything in the read-back is right, say yes. If the assistant mentions a membership, say 'no thanks'.

checks.name: asked_safety_screen
checks.question: Did the assistant ask, early in the call, whether the caller smells gas or has a carbon monoxide alarm going off?

checks.name: one_question_at_a_time
checks.question: Did the assistant mostly ask one question per turn, rather than stacking several questions or reading out a list of options?

checks.name: read_back_before_booking
checks.question: Before confirming the booking, did the assistant read back the name, the address, the day and arrival window, and the problem, and ask the caller to confirm?

checks.name: booking_confirmed
checks.question: Did the assistant tell the caller the appointment is booked, with a specific day and arrival window?

checks.name: membership_once_not_pushy
checks.question: If Comfort Club or membership was mentioned, was it mentioned at most once, after the booking, and dropped when the caller declined? (If it was never mentioned, answer true.)
